idiom_name: frozen dataclass variants + X | Y union alias + match/case
implementation_notes: Variants are frozen dataclasses, the sum is an alias over the PEP 604 union syntax (X | Y, 3.10), and match/case with class patterns both selects the variant and destructures its fields; dataclasses generate __match_args__ so positional patterns work. Python 3.11's typing.assert_never lets a static checker prove that the final branch is unreachable for the declared union. The union is closed only to a static type checker: at run time any object can satisfy the alias, so validate untrusted data before constructing a variant.
pitfalls: A bare capture pattern (case other:) matches everything and silently stops the match from being exhaustive; use case _ with assert_never so a new variant fails the type check.
The union alias is erased at run time, so isinstance(shape, Shape) is a TypeError - test the concrete variant classes instead.
Frozen dataclasses prevent rebinding but not mutation of a mutable field (a list component is still shared); use tuples or frozen collections inside variants.

variants.name: Enum tag + dataclasses + isinstance dispatch (Python 3.7-3.9)
variants.idiom_name: typing.Union of dataclasses + Enum tag + isinstance chain
variants.implementation_notes: On Python 3.7-3.9 there is no X | Y union syntax and no match statement, so the sum is written as typing.Union[Circle, Square] and dispatched with an isinstance chain or a tag-to-handler mapping; dataclasses still supply the product half. If a wire format needs a tag, make it derived or init=False so callers cannot contradict the concrete variant. This is the same model as the 3.10+ form with weaker ergonomics - destructuring happens by attribute access rather than by pattern - and it is the form legacy codebases still run.
pitfalls: An isinstance chain has no exhaustiveness signal at all; the final raise is the only detection, and a type checker sees Union members rather than a closed set.

Wrong move: expose a caller-settable Enum tag beside the concrete class -> Failure: a Circle can claim Kind.SQUARE and serializers route it to the wrong payload -> Instead: derive the tag from the class or set the field with init=False.
A typing.Union alias has no runtime validator, so isinstance dispatch still accepts an unrelated object until the final raise -> validate wire data before constructing a variant.
